evidence_policy: Generated by `report` from campaign JSONL kept outside the repository. Nothing here is hand-written; every gate is not_measured until a record supports a verdict.

G1.title: correctness
G1.reason: no violations across recorded evidence; minimum evidence set complete

G2.title: exactness
G2.reason: agreement wherever the old search completed

G4.title: coverage
G4.reason: checks n4=ok, n5=missing, n6=ok, n7=missing, n8=ok, R22=ok, R23=ok

G5.title: timing
G5.reason: requires the production hard backstop (a separate PR); the planner checkpoint is not that backstop

G6.title: overshoot
G6.reason: requires the production hard backstop (a separate PR); the planner checkpoint is not that backstop

G8.title: metadata
G8.reason: each stop kind observed with clean metadata
